units.source_text: 夕雾在回京路上怅望秋夜长空，正值十三夜的月亮幽艳地照临天际。

en.t: On the road back to the capital, Yugiri gazed wistfully at the long autumn night sky, while the thirteenth-night moon shone with a faint, haunting beauty at the edge of heaven.

units.source_text: 车辆从容地驱过小仓山时，道经落叶公主本邸一条院。

en.t: As the carriage moved unhurriedly past Mount Ogura, the road brought him by Ichijo-in, Princess Ochiba's main residence.

units.source_text: 但见这宫邸已甚荒凉，西南方的土墙已经坍塌，可以望见内部各处殿宇，

en.t: He saw that the mansion had fallen into deep desolation; the earthen wall on the southwest side had collapsed, leaving the various buildings inside open to view.

units.source_text: 窗户都关闭着，静悄悄地不见人影，只有月亮皎洁地映在池塘之中。

en.t: All the shutters were closed, and in the hush not a person could be seen; only the bright moon was reflected clearly in the pond.

units.source_text: 夕雾回思柏木大纳言昔年在此举行管弦之会时的光景，独自即景吟诗：

en.t: Yugiri remembered the scene from years before, when the Grand Counselor Kashiwagi had held a music gathering here, and he composed a poem alone on the spot:
